transition.text: Term-limited. Byron Donalds (Republican) won the governorship (NBC News projection, unofficial; the National Governors Association lists the same winner) and takes office in January 2027.

statewideTerm: The Governor and Cabinet were elected in 2022 for terms ending in January 2027; those elected on November 3, 2026 take office then. Florida's Secretary of State is appointed.

notes.election: A general election was held on November 3, 2026. This roster lists officials in office on the build date; people elected on November 3 take office in January 2027 and are not shown yet.
